source.edition: Rugby League Project, the 1969 NSWRFL premiership
source.label: NSWRFL (computed)

conversion.formula: Players: everyone the Rugby League Project lists as taking the field in the NSWRFL's 1969 premiership, its finals included; his club the one he played most games for (of two as many, the first RLP lists). Position: the one he started at most that season (RLP's starts by position; the bench is no start), else in the seasons either side, then two either side; else he is left out. Value: his selections, the games he started for his club and his representative games (Tests, State of Origin or the interstate series, NSW City v Country), plus 2 for each try at today's 4 tries a team game, scaled to his season's rate (`tryRate`), per club game, the season before at half weight when he played in it. Overall: the value's mid-rank percentile among the season's players at his position, read off Rugby League 26's overalls at that position by as many of each 2025 club's best as the season's clubs carry per club (`quota`), by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1-99. Club shift: the season's results set each club's target: its Simple Rating System, the regular season's points margin a game adjusted for its opponents and a home edge by least squares, ranked among the season's clubs (mid-rank percentiles) and read off `clubShift.reference`, the built-in 2025 NRL clubs' strengths. Every player of the club moves by the one whole number that brings its matchday 17's strength closest to the target (of two as close, the smaller move), held to 1-99.
conversion.metric: selections (club starts and representative games) and tries a club game, the previous season at half weight

clubShift.note: Each club's `team`: its regular season's Simple Rating System (`srs`, points a game, home edge `homeEdge`), its target, its lineup's strength unshifted (`strength`) and shifted (`shifted`), and the shift.

columns: previous season [games, clubs (season/code), [starts, representative games, tries]]
